pipeline_metadata.bootstrap_algorithm: one PCG64 engine bootstrap within each frozen reserved role

fit.eligibility_rule: C<T using the training lifetime; ineligible draws remain recorded and are excluded

tune.eligibility_rule: C<T using the training lifetime; ineligible draws remain recorded and are excluded

calibration.eligibility_rule: C<T using the training lifetime; ineligible draws remain recorded and are excluded

anchor.source: fixed original eligible calibration sensor prefixes

pipeline_metadata.multiplicity_interpretation: Repeated rows encode bootstrap multiplicity for the same ID; they do not create new independent engines.
pipeline_metadata.empirical_perturbation_limit: The planned eight conditional perturbations do not estimate true total pipeline sampling uncertainty or independent loss/performance.

calibration.calibration_outcomes_use: correction only; not CQR or prior/algorithm selection
calibration.guarantee_limitation: Bootstrap copies repeat engine scores and are not independent calibration engines; official cutoff transport is also unverified.
calibration.selection_rule: 12 fixed candidates; lowest uncalibrated tuning mean 90% interval score; within 0.5 cycles prefer linear, then the existing deterministic simplicity key
